vw_methodology_steps.step_description: Collect structured Australian job advertisements with configured local source provenance.
Map source fields, remove duplicates, and standardise canonical job attributes.
Match governed aliases against section-aware text and retain deterministic scores.
Apply governed role, seniority and relevance rules before distinct-job analytics.
Validate 26 frozen view contracts, write one JSON source, then convert it to Excel.

vw_limitations.limitation_text: The analysis covers advertised jobs and not the full hidden labour market.
Many advertisements omit salary information, limiting comparisons.

vw_limitations.limitation_title: Inconsistent job titles - Ex: Data Guru or Data Magician
vw_limitations.limitation_text: Role classification must use job descriptions and use rule based classification because titles can be ambiguous.
Skills require a maintained governed alias dictionary.
Findings that would be valid for the analysis period may change over time.
Jobs with uncertain relevance or classification are excluded from dashboard analysis until manually reviewed and validated.

vw_project_metadata.project_description: Governed Australian job-market skills, roles, seniority and location insights.
